name: Gakuen Bakuretsu Tenkousei!
source:
A strong girl transferred to a new girls' school and moved in with a room-mate. That day, she got the school regulation girl upset at her. Next day, her room-mate is missing and she went searching the school for her room-mate. What she finds are a bunch of nasty stuff. If you can get her pass the four bad endings, she can rescue her room-mate, even if a bit late.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一名强悍女孩转入新的女子学校，并与室友共同生活。入学当天，她便惹恼了负责维护校规的女生。第二天，室友突然失踪，她开始在校园里四处寻找，最终发现了一连串恶心内幕。只要避开四种坏结局，她便能救出室友——即使可能稍微迟了一点。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
